datasets.name: Operational state audit and outbox
datasets.ownershipDecision: Authority is partitioned by named aggregate. Domain components decide transitions; unit-of-work is the sole delegated transaction writer. Domain state, mutation result, audit and outbox intent commit atomically.

datasets.name: Partner receipts and attempt progress
datasets.ownershipDecision: ERP adapter owns integration receipts and reconciliation progress; upstream ERP owns posting truth.

datasets.name: Consumer progress and downstream intent
datasets.ownershipDecision: Persist deduplication, checkpoint and downstream intent atomically; retries never advance checkpoint before durable effects or retained work.

datasets.name: Message receipts and deduplication

decisions.name: Deployment boundary rationale
decisions.context: Interactive dispatch must survive slow provider calls, scans and projection replay.
decisions.decision: Propose one modular operational application, plus separate partner integration, replay/report, document, notification and live-delivery applications. Keep domain modules in one transaction boundary.
decisions.consequence: Splits isolate credentials, untrusted files, long jobs and connection fanout. A simpler deployment may combine workers after measured workload review.

decisions.name: Offline conflict and revocation policy
decisions.context: Technicians may reconnect with old assignments or revoked membership.
decisions.decision: Propose explicit expectedVersion and mutationId, authoritative reauthorization, visible conflict resolution and no silent last-write-wins. Owner: product and security.
decisions.consequence: Pending work remains visible; revoked access blocks replay and local credentials are cleared. Lost-device encryption and erasure implementation must be scoped before production.

decisions.name: Retention legal hold and derivative erasure
decisions.context: No commercial retention policy, jurisdiction or legal-hold matrix has been supplied.
decisions.decision: Unresolved. Product, security and legal owners must define per-dataset retention and device/export lifetime. Zero catalog retention is an unspecified sentinel; it is not permission to retain forever.
decisions.consequence: Production scope is blocked for evidence, audit, device journals, financial receipts and derived erasure until explicit policy and acceptance are supplied.

decisions.name: Recovery and broker retention
decisions.context: Business loss tolerance, peak workload, SLO and restore priorities are unknown.
decisions.decision: Unresolved. Operations and product owners must set RPO/RTO, event retention, replay/deduplication window, dead-letter escalation and queue capacity. Numeric defaults are illustrative only.
decisions.consequence: Production capacity and disaster recovery remain excluded. Replays use durable checkpoints and version checks; no current design or runtime pass proves recovery.

decisions.name: Uncertain external financial effects
decisions.context: An ERP may accept a posting while the client sees a timeout.
decisions.decision: Propose trusted tenant mapping, provider idempotency, persisted attempts and reconciliation before resending uncertain financial effects. ERP remains financial authority.
decisions.consequence: Service completion can be confirmed independently while financial settlement remains pending; manual exception review is required when provider status cannot be established.

decisions.name: Evidence quarantine and publication
decisions.context: Uploaded files are untrusted and access may be revoked after upload.
decisions.decision: Propose immutable quarantine, hash-bound scan verdict and domain-controlled release. Current authorization guards service-mediated download; report exports follow the same rule.
decisions.consequence: Scanner, file restrictions, malware engine, maximum object size and security acceptance are unresolved; no evidence is customer-visible while pending or rejected.
